ulm_full.staging: The board as the campaign opens: Mack in Swabia, six French corps in the four provinces round him. Ney attacks.
ulm_full.shows: a great battle won: 2 corps march to the guns as the wings, 3 more in reserve, Soult awaits orders, the enemy's line broken

the_capitulation.staging: The board as the campaign opens: Mack in Swabia, six French corps in the four provinces round him. Ney attacks.
the_capitulation.shows: Mack is taken on the field.

last_hour.staging: The board as the campaign opens: Mack in Swabia, six French corps in the four provinces round him. Ney attacks.
last_hour.shows: Murat comes up at the last hour (his march: 58, where 55 was needed)

the_flank.staging: Two attacks on Swabia in one turn: Lannes goes in first from Franche-Comte, then Ney from the Rhineland: the second comes in on a flank.
the_flank.shows: The attack comes in from 2 provinces (Franche-Comte, Rhineland): +1 on the dice.

ordinary_brief.staging: Lannes alone against the Archduke John in the Tyrol; nobody near.
ordinary_brief.shows: an ordinary exchange (defender_tactical_victory): the brief form

defeat_defending.staging: The enemy's turn: Mack falls on Bernadotte in Franconia, the Archduke John in the Tyrol beside it.
defeat_defending.shows: a defeat on the defence: the player's line on the left, beaten

observed_full.staging: Two courts' war in full sight: Kutuzov against Hohenlohe in Silesia.
observed_full.shows: another court's battle, seen in full: the observer's register

the_day_hangs.staging: Davout against the Archduke John in the mountains, nobody near.
the_day_hangs.shows: neither line gives way: the day hangs

the_guns.staging: Marmont's guns, commissioned and ordered to support Ney, fire first.
the_guns.shows: a supporting battery fires before the assault

enemy_comes.staging: Davout, from Munich, attacks Kutuzov in the Tyrol; Buxhowden stands in Bohemia beside the field, ordered to support Kutuzov: the enemy's corps comes up unseen. (An Austrian corps cannot be staged for this: the court's doctrine holds the Archduke John's best march, 67, under his bar of 70 — the Hofkriegsrat's slowness is the game's, not the tool's.)
enemy_comes.shows: Buxhowden comes up unseen and is turned up on arrival

the_reserve.staging: Ulm with the whole Austrian army in Swabia: the Archdukes John and Charles beside Mack, and Schwarzenberg and Hiller commissioned from the pool. Four corps a side on the table, the French reserve behind: the deepest line the table seats.
the_reserve.shows: three corps a side on the table, 3 and 1 more in reserve (attacker_tactical_victory)

two_a_side.staging: Davout and Lannes against Kutuzov and Buxhowden in the Tyrol: two corps a side — a lead and one wing each.
two_a_side.shows: two corps a side: a lead and a wing each (defender_tactical_victory)

our_dispositions.staging: The enemy's turn: Mack falls on Bernadotte in Franconia, who stands behind field works on the defensive.
our_dispositions.shows: Your dispositions: Bernadotte holds behind field works (+16%); a defensive posture (+15%).

square_and_horse.staging: Murat's horse, from Munich, rides at the Archduke John in the Tyrol, who has formed square.
square_and_horse.shows: Archduke John's squares stand against the horse (−40%).

assault_held.staging: Ney, from Bohemia, storms Vienna: the capital's garrison of 25,000 and no corps in it.
assault_held.shows: a garrison assault: the wall held (THE ASSAULT FAILS)

assault_stormed.staging: Vienna held by 6,000: the assault carries the wall and the city falls.
assault_stormed.shows: a garrison assault: the wall stormed (THE WALLS ARE CARRIED)

assault_occupied.staging: Vienna held by 6,000 under a fortress: the wall is carried and the occupation begins.
assault_occupied.shows: a garrison assault: the wall stormed (THE WALLS ARE CARRIED)

assault_capitulated.staging: A detachment of 3,000 in Vienna, assaulted at more than four to one: it lays down its arms.
assault_capitulated.shows: a garrison assault: the wall capitulated (THE GARRISON CAPITULATES)

assault_on_ours.staging: The enemy's turn: Mack, from Artois, storms Paris — our own garrison.
assault_on_ours.shows: the enemy storms our garrison: THE WALLS HOLD

bombard_link.staging: Marmont's guns, in the Rhineland, bombard Mack in Swabia: the cannonade alone.
bombard_link.shows: a bombardment: a link by default, the cannonade alone

bombard_levels.staging: Mack behind light field works: one salvo brings them down to nothing.
bombard_levels.shows: a bombardment that levels the works: it opens by itself

bombard_ours.staging: Lannes stands in Swabia with Mack as Marmont's guns open on him: our own corps is caught under our own fire.
bombard_ours.shows: Our own Lannes, standing by, is caught under the guns: 636 fall.

day_opens.staging: Masséna, from the Tyrol, falls on the Archduke Charles in Carniola with no other corps near: 96,000 men engaged — a great battle, two corps, and a day whose chips fit the panel.
day_opens.shows: a great battle whose day hangs, awaiting our word: 2 points to 2, 2 lit order chip(s) (Massena presses, Massena digs in), the stand, leave-it and break-off words

day_dim_chip.staging: Masséna, from the Tyrol, falls on the Archduke Charles in Carniola with no other corps near: 96,000 men engaged — a great battle, two corps, and a day whose chips fit the panel.
day_dim_chip.shows: a day with its purse spent: 2 chip(s) dim with a reason ('Massena presses': "The day's points are spent."), 3 word(s) still lit

day_word.staging: Masséna, from the Tyrol, falls on the Archduke Charles in Carniola with no other corps near: 96,000 men engaged — a great battle, two corps, and a day whose chips fit the panel.
day_word.shows: the clash after our word ('Massena presses the attack.'): 1 of 2 points to 2 and the day still hangs, his clash following

day_night.staging: Masséna, from the Tyrol, falls on the Archduke Charles in Carniola with no other corps near: 96,000 men engaged — a great battle, two corps, and a day whose chips fit the panel.
day_night.shows: a day closed by night: the last clash told, 'Night falls on an undecided field.', no chips

day_defence.staging: The enemy's turn: the Archduke Charles, from Carniola, falls on Masséna in the Tyrol — a great battle the ENEMY opened, whose day awaits us.
day_defence.shows: a day the enemy opened against us, awaiting our word: 2 points to 3, 'Fall back' among the chips, lit

day_crowded.staging: Ulm with the whole Austrian army and every French corps in reach (`_stage_four`'s board): a day with thirteen chips, more than the panel's room holds on two lines.
day_crowded.shows: a crowded day: 13 chips (every corps of ours in reach of the field offers a press and a bring-up)

day_follows.staging: Masséna, from the Tyrol, falls on the Archduke Charles in Carniola with no other corps near: 96,000 men engaged — a great battle, two corps, and a day whose chips fit the panel.
day_follows.shows: OUR clash's tableau when he strikes back: follows=true and no chips (2 of 2 points to 3); his clash comes next

day_follows_his.staging: Masséna, from the Tyrol, falls on the Archduke Charles in Carniola with no other corps near: 96,000 men engaged — a great battle, two corps, and a day whose chips fit the panel.
day_follows_his.shows: HIS clash's tableau after ours: the day's live chips (5) ride it (2 to 2, his temper 'Cautious')

day_ulm.staging: The board as the campaign opens: Mack in Swabia, six French corps in the four provinces round him. Ney attacks.
day_ulm.shows: the real Ulm opening: Mack surrounded (his_road false, 'Literal'), the day open, the lead's press lit among 13 chips

day_guns.staging: The real Ulm opening with TWO French batteries in reach of the field and not in its province (Marmont and Sénarmont, commissioned from the pool and set in the Rhineland beside Swabia): the day offers all three groups — "Another leads", "Bring up" and "The guns".
day_guns.shows: the day offers all three groups on the real Ulm opening: 5 'Another leads', 3 'Bring up', 2 'The guns' (16 chips in all)

day_decided.staging: The board as the campaign opens: Mack in Swabia, six French corps in the four provinces round him. Ney attacks.
day_decided.shows: a day decided by its clash (the Guard goes in at Ulm): the day is closed with no banner of its own — the table builds no panel and stands as any battle's
